enable_widget_actions.description: Kill-switch to enable or disable interactive background actions (start/stop) from the widget.

enable_sue_local_ai.description: Kill-switch for SUE on-device Gemma LLM inference. If false, SUE operates purely on deterministic Fast-Path.

sue_model_url.description: Remote OTA download URL for SUE AI model. If empty, uses the app default release URL.

maintenance_message.description: Optional maintenance notice message for users.
